title: TEST-003 bounded fuzz campaign evidence
description: Machine-checkable evidence record for the bounded JMeter 5.6.3 parser and boundary fuzz campaign. A planned/not-run record is explicitly non-evidence and cannot imply execution. Draft 2020-12 validates the closed shapes, exact target/invariant/corpus values, and status conditions; the repository static/xtask meta-validator must additionally enforce cross-array foreign keys, unique artifact IDs and paths, artifact joins, campaign/toolchain joins, count arithmetic, and aggregate artifact caps.
